basic_details.job_title: Kozhikode District Court Office Attendant/Peon Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District Court, Kozhikode (ജില്ലാ കോടതി, കോഴിക്കോട്) is preparing a list of eligible persons for contract appointment to 2 expected vacancies of Office Attendant/Peon (ഓഫീസ് അറ്റന്റന്റ്/പ്യൂൺ) in the Special Fast Track Court (POCSO) at Koyilandy. Applications in the prescribed form go to The District Judge, District Court, Court Complex, Kozhikode - 673032, by hand or by post, and must reach before 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026. Only retired staff can apply.

qualification.details: Applicants must be retired from the court service in the post they apply for or a higher post. If retired court staff are not available, retirees of other departments will also be considered. Age: applicants must not have completed 62 years of age. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. The notice prints no separate educational qualification or experience requirement; for details, candidates should check the official notification.

selection_process: Selection is based on scrutiny of applications
qualifications and an interview. Appointments to Office Attendant/Peon will be made from the list prepared
in order of priority. The notice gives no interview date.
important_instructions: The appointment is for 179 continuous days, or until the appointee completes 62 years of age, whichever comes first. Selected persons must enter into an agreement with the Government, combining the conditions of Kerala Service Rules Part I, Appendix I and G.O.(P) 81/2019/Fin dated 09.07.2019. The notice describes the engagement as contract-basis; the application form and envelope wording call it temporary appointment. Office contact printed in the notice: telephone 0495-2366091, fax 0495-2761590, emails [email protected] and [email protected]. The notice does not ask for applications by email.

content_sections.heading: About Kozhikode District Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the District Court, Kozhikode, under the Civil Judiciary, Kozhikode district. The vacancies are expected in the Special Fast Track Court that deals only with sexual offences against children (POCSO) cases and functions at Koyilandy. The appointing authority is the District Judge, Kozhikode.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Prepare a complete biodata in the format given with the notice (the application form is on page 3 of the notice). Attach attested copies of certificates proving age, qualification and experience. Address: The District Judge, District Court, Court Complex, Kozhikode - 673032. Mode: by hand or by post, so that it is received before 5.00 PM on 30.11.2026. Envelope: write the notification number and "Application for temporary appointment" (താത്ക്കാലിക നിയമനത്തിനുള്ള അപേക്ഷ) on top of the cover. The notice says this is mandatory. Applications received after the stipulated time will not be considered. The application form asks for: a recent passport size photo; name in Malayalam and in English capital letters; mobile number; age and date of birth; date of retirement and PPO number; post retired from; educational qualification; present address; work experience; other qualifications; and a declaration with place, date, name and signature.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Applicants must be retired from the court service in the post they apply for or a higher post. If retired court staff are not available, retirees of other departments will also be considered. Age: applicants must not have completed 62 years of age. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. The notice prints no separate educational qualification or experience requirement; for details, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Complete biodata in the prescribed application form, with a recent passport size photo affixed. Attested copies of certificates proving age. Attested copies of certificates proving qualification. Attested copies of certificates proving work experience.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on scrutiny of applications, qualifications and an interview. Appointments to Office Attendant/Peon will be made from the list prepared, in order of priority. The notice gives no interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is for 179 continuous days, or until the appointee completes 62 years of age, whichever comes first. Selected persons must enter into an agreement with the Government, combining the conditions of Kerala Service Rules Part I, Appendix I and G.O.(P) 81/2019/Fin dated 09.07.2019. The notice describes the engagement as contract-basis; the application form and envelope wording call it temporary appointment. Office contact printed in the notice: telephone 0495-2366091, fax 0495-2761590, emails [email protected] and [email protected] . The notice does not ask for applications by email.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Kozhikode District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 2 expected vacancies of Office Attendant/Peon in the POCSO Special Fast Track Court, Koyilandy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Judge, Kozhikode before 5.00 PM on 30 November 2026. Late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Office Attendant/Peon post?
faq.answer: Persons retired from courts from the same post or a higher post can apply. If such retired court staff are not available, retirees of other departments will also be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Applicants must not have completed 62 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Office Attendant/Peon post?
faq.answer: The monthly salary printed in the notice is 20280/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed application with attested copies of age, qualification and experience certificates, by hand or by post, to The District Judge, District Court, Court Complex, Kozhikode - 673032.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The notification number (A1- 11625/2026) and "Application for temporary appointment" must be written on top of the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on scrutiny of applications, qualifications and an interview, and appointments are made from the prepared list in order of priority.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for 179 continuous days, or until the appointee completes 62 years, whichever comes first, under an agreement with the Government.
